caption: The drawing features several detailed views and measurements of a decorative wooden chair. The main objects include an ornate chair back rest with carved acanthus leaves and scrollwork in shades of brown, a vertical detail of a twisted, rope-like wooden element also in brown, and two views of the full chair: a front elevation and a side elevation. The chair legs and frame are illustrated in reddish-brown, while the seat cushion is depicted in blue with white horizontal stripes. Various dimensions are marked throughout the drawing, with measurements such as “5’ 8” across the chair back, “20” and “13” across the front legs, and “18 1/2” for the seat depth. The side view shows the seat’s padding and how it sits on the wooden frame, and the decorative wood carving is indicated both from the front and the side. All the outlined forms are rendered in colored pencil and ink, combining line work and shaded areas in brown, blue, and grey tones.
title: Side Chair
